question.explanation: Twenty-nine astronauts flew on the numbered Apollo missions: 24 traveled to the Moon's vicinity, while five others flew only on the Earth-orbiting Apollo 7 or Apollo 9 missions. Apollo 1 never launched, and Skylab and Apollo–Soyuz flights are not included here.

provenance.brief: Name an astronaut who flew on an Apollo mission.

quotes.Neil Armstrong: Neil A. Armstrong – Commander of Gemini 8, commanded Apollo 11, becoming the first human to set foot on the Moon.
quotes.Buzz Aldrin: Edwin E. "Buzz" Aldrin Jr. – Second-seat veteran on Gemini 12, flew as Lunar Module Pilot on Apollo 11, the first Moon landing.
quotes.Michael Collins: Michael Collins – Second-seat veteran on Gemini 10, flew as Command Module Pilot on Apollo 11.
quotes.Jim Lovell: James A. Lovell Jr. – Second-seat veteran of Gemini 7, and commander of Gemini 12, flew as Command Module Pilot (second seat) on Apollo 8. Lovell became the first to fly a second Apollo mission as commander of Apollo 13, the third lunar landing attempt.
quotes.John Young: John W. Young – Second-seat veteran of Gemini 3 and commander of Gemini 10, flew as Command Module Pilot on Apollo 10. Young later commanded the successful Apollo 16 lunar landing.
quotes.Eugene Cernan: Eugene A. Cernan – Second-seat veteran on Gemini 9A, flew as Lunar Module Pilot on Apollo 10, and commanded the final lunar landing mission Apollo 17.
quotes.Pete Conrad: Charles "Pete" Conrad Jr. – Second-seat veteran of Gemini 5 and commander of Gemini 11, commanded Apollo 12, the second lunar landing.
quotes.Frank Borman: 1 | | Frank Borman (NASA Astronaut Group 2) | (1928-03-14)March 14, 1928 | November 7, 2023(2023-11-07) (aged 95) | 40 | Apollo 8 December 21–27, 1968
quotes.Bill Anders: William A. Anders – Flew third seat on Apollo 8.
quotes.Jack Swigert: John L. "Jack" Swigert Jr. – Flew as Mattingly's backup on Apollo 13.
quotes.Fred Haise: Fred W. Haise Jr. – Flew as Lunar Module Pilot on the unsuccessful Apollo 13.
quotes.David Scott: David R. Scott – Second-seat veteran of Gemini 8, flew as Command Module Pilot on Apollo 9, and commanded the Apollo 15 lunar landing.
quotes.Alan Bean: Alan L. Bean – Flew as Lunar Module Pilot on Apollo 12. He later served as commander for Skylab 3.
quotes.Harrison Schmitt: Group 4 – the scientist astronaut group; Harrison Schmitt (center), who became NASA's first scientist astronaut to fly in space, explored the Moon on Apollo 17.
quotes.Charles Duke: Duke flew as Lunar Module Pilot on Apollo 16.
quotes.Edgar Mitchell: Edgar D. Mitchell – Lunar Module Pilot on Apollo 14.
quotes.James Irwin: James B. Irwin – Lunar Module Pilot on Apollo 15.
quotes.Tom Stafford: Thomas P. Stafford – Second-seat veteran of Gemini 6A and commander of Gemini 9A, commanded a lunar orbital test of the Lunar Module on Apollo 10.
